summary_1line: After burning Lanka, Hanuman fears Sita may have died in the fire and condemns his anger before reassuring himself of her purity and possible safety.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman stands on a cliff above the burning city of Lanka, watching flames devour the golden palaces as worry overtakes his face.
The fire-tailed Hanuman plunges his blazing tail into the ocean, steam rising as the inferno behind him engulfs Lanka.
Hanuman sits alone amid smoke and embers, head bowed in despair as he imagines Sita lost in the flames of the city.
